# govulncheck accepted-advisory allowlist
#
# One OSV/Go advisory ID per line. Anything govulncheck reports that is NOT
# listed here fails the gate, so this file narrows the gate, it never disables
# it. Every entry needs a reason and a tracking issue.
#
# Format: <GO-ID>  # <reason> (tracking: #<issue>)
#
# Removing an entry is part of closing its tracking issue.

# github.com/lib/pq — 7 advisories, every one "Fixed in: N/A". No published
# version of lib/pq is unaffected (v1.12.3 -> 7 affected, v1.10.9 -> 5), so
# there is nothing to bump to; the module is no longer getting security fixes.
# Real fix is migrating to jackc/pgx v5, tracked in #232.
# Exploitation requires a malicious PostgreSQL endpoint or an active MITM on an
# unauthenticated transport. nSelf connects to the operator's own stack.
